high_court_outcome.correct_value: High Court reversed the trial court's acquittal and convicted both accused under IPC s.304-B, s.498-A and DPA s.4, with life, 3 years RI and 6 months RI, concurrent.
high_court_outcome.quote: The appellants - the husband and mother-in-law of the deceased - were acquitted by the trial court but the High Court convicted them under Sections 304B, 498-A IPC and Section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act
high_court_outcome.reason: The sentences are right, but the High Court reversed the acquittal and convicted; it did not 'uphold' convictions.
